definitions.gloss: high praise, rave review, great acclaim
definitions.explanation: Extremely enthusiastic praise or approval. Used when something receives overwhelmingly positive reviews or reactions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{批評家|ひひょうか}→批評家：19430_hihyouka⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{絶賛|ぜっさん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The critics gave it rave reviews.

examples.japanese: {絶賛|ぜっさん}⟦{発売中|はつばいちゅう}→発売中：22137_hatsubaichuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{試|ため}し→お試し：09820_otameshi⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please try our new product, now on sale to great acclaim.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{絶賛|ぜっさん}⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{数々|かずかず}→数々：12722_kazukazu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: This film was highly acclaimed overseas as well and won numerous awards.

notes:
USAGE:
Very commonly used in advertising and marketing Japanese. The phrase {絶賛|ぜっさん}⟦{発売中|はつばいちゅう}→発売中：22137_hatsubaichuu⟧ (now on sale to great acclaim) and {絶賛|ぜっさん}{公開中|こうかいちゅう} (now showing to great acclaim) are standard promotional expressions. In more neutral contexts, it genuinely conveys exceptional praise.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Functions as a noun and a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {絶賛|ぜっさん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to highly praise). Often appears in passive: {絶賛|ぜっさん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be highly praised).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶賛|ぜっさん}⟦{発売中|はつばいちゅう}→発売中：22137_hatsubaichuu⟧: on sale to great acclaim
- {絶賛|ぜっさん}{公開中|こうかいちゅう}: now showing to great acclaim
- {絶賛|ぜっさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: voices of high praise
- {絶賛|ぜっさん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be highly acclaimed
